verdict.rationale: Medusa maintains complete machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 specs for its Store and Admin REST APIs, and these specs power the public API reference at docs.medusajs.com/api, so the product can be driven programmatically through documented endpoints. Community reports describing it as a headless platform corroborate this API-driven model, and webhook events add event-driven integration. The 404s on guessed OpenAPI paths only mean the spec isn't served at a well-known URL, not that the API is undocumented. Missing for 10: the spec is not discoverable at a standard well-known OpenAPI URL, and there is no independent hands-on report of an agent driving the API.
